senses.gloss: सृमर॑ mfn. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 160) going, going well or quickly, W.
सृमर॑ m. a kind of animal frequenting damp places (accord. to some the ‘Bos Grunniens’ or ‘a young deer’), MBh.; R. &c.
N. of an Asura (cf. सृमल, सृम, and सृप, col. 3), Hariv.
सृभ् or सृम्भ् (cf. √ सिभ्, स्रिभ्) cl. 1. P. सर्भति, सृम्भति, to kill, slay, injure, Dhātup. xi, 40.
सृ॑म m. N. of an Asura (cf. सृप above and सृमर col. 1), MaitrS.
सृमल m. N. of an Asura (v.l. समल), Hariv.
